stemMd: Four people each shake hands once with every other person. How many handshakes occur?
explanationMd: There are 4 times 3 person-to-person counts, but each handshake is counted twice. Dividing 12 by 2 gives 6 distinct pairs.

distractorRationale.c: This is not the number of unordered pairs.
distractorRationale.a: Each person shakes three hands, not one.
distractorRationale.d: This counts each handshake from both participants.
